put.description:
Receive the bytes of a granted job output. The grant's token is the credential.

Bytes that do not match the declared size and SHA-256 fail the job. A
file uploaded against an interface is checked against it as it streams
in: its size and leading bytes, and its content when it is JSON or JSON
Lines no larger than ``storage.validate_json_max_bytes`` (a larger one is
recorded as not content-validated). At most
``storage.max_concurrent_validations`` uploads are content-validated at
once; the others wait (503 once they waited ``max_stream_seconds``). A
file that does not match is refused with ``invalid_content``, as soon as
a fatal problem shows, without reading the rest: nothing is kept, the
grant is spent and records the problems, and the job keeps its lease, so
the tester reports the job's failure, naming the step that wrote the
file. That record is what blames a producer's output on the agent. A
grant sent in parts (``direct.transfer = "multipart"``) cannot be streamed.

post.description:
Claim the oldest waiting job of the phase (`verify` by default) the caller
may perform.

A verifier service account names the policy revision it applies and claims
only the runner jobs its project's science revision registers under its
account name and that revision. An agent service account or a researcher
names no revision and claims agent jobs, never one of an attempt it ran
itself.

With `phase: document`, an agent service account or a researcher claims
the oldest waiting document job: it writes up a hypothesis whose last
attempt was verified, or that a researcher stopped after a failure.

With `phase: decide`, the decider service account a science revision
registers names the revision of its step and claims the oldest waiting
decide job registered to it: it decides a written-up hypothesis on its
decision case.

Replaying an ``Idempotency-Key`` while its claim still holds the lease
reissues the lease token under the next lease generation (the first
response may have been lost); the earlier token and every upload grant
issued under it stop working.

Publish a verify job's report with the manifest of its outputs, or a

The report is Markdown with YAML front matter (``verification.schema.json``)
and an optional body. The attempt is then verified, and the hypothesis waits
for its write-up in a document job. Repeating a completion returns the completed job without publishing
again. An invalid report from a runner is an infrastructure failure of the
job: it reruns from the failed step or fails the attempt for human review.
An invalid report from an agent or a researcher is refused and the lease
is kept, so it can be corrected and sent again.

A document job is completed with the write-up (``writeup.schema.json``)
and no manifest: it covers every attempt of the hypothesis and cites the
verification report the job names. The hypothesis then awaits its
decision. An invalid write-up is refused and the lease is kept.

A decide job is completed by its decider with the decision document
(``decision.schema.json``) and no manifest: it is recorded on the
hypothesis's decision case with the decider as its actor. A promotion
requires a `pass` verdict. An invalid decision document is refused and
the lease is kept.

hypothesis or attempt; the argument as its body.

ConfigRevisionRequest.description: The config-kind path selects the matching published revision contract.

controls.description: Stored legacy controls may predate the fixed hypothesis control contract.

ContextBundleRef.description: Where to read an attempt's context bundle, and its size in bytes.

ContextItem.description:
Something a unit's performer should read: another unit (`unit`: a
hypothesis number or a key of the same plan), an attempt's write-up
(`writeup`: `unit` number and `attempt` sequence) or an artifact
(`artifact`: its id). `note` says why it matters.

actor_service_id.description: The decider service account that recorded an automatic decision.

actor_user_id.description: The researcher who decided; null for an automatic decision.

decider_revision.description: The revision of the decider step that wrote an automatic decision.

DocumentPhase.description: A phase whose output documents have a published front matter schema.

ErrorResponse.description: The public domain-error envelope used by authentication and REST validation.

HttpDetail.description: A transport error produced before the domain controller receives the body.

HumanDecisionRequest.description:
A decision on a review case. A decision case takes the decision
document (and `supersedes` for a correction); a failure case takes
`action`, `evidence_revision` and `reason`.

document.description:
Decision case: the decision document, Markdown with YAML front matter
(`decision.schema.json`) whose body is the reason.

evidence_revision.description: Failure case: the failure revision decided on.

HypothesisDocument.description: Stored historical hypotheses can predate the full publication document.

oneOf.description: The brief revision the job's attempt pinned, absent when it has none.

Where to read the attempt's context bundle, and its size; absent
with `plan`.

The plan revision the attempt pinned at its claim; absent when its
track had no approved plan then.

phase.description:
The phase to claim a job of: `verify` (the default), `document`, or
`decide` (a decider service account).

document.description: The verification report: Markdown with YAML front matter.

claimed_by.description: The service account that claimed the job.

claimed_by_user.description: The researcher who claimed the job.

performer.description:
`runner` (a verifier service account runs it) or `agent` (an agent
service account or a researcher who did not run the attempt).

oneOf.description: The verification report the job published.

verifier.description: The verifier service account registered to run a runner job.

oneOf.description: The write-up a document job published.

PlanApproach.description: The draft's approach: the track's shared reasoning, risks and edge cases.

PlanCheckOut.description: What blocks submitting the draft; `ready` when nothing does.

PlanOut.description: One revision of a track's plan with its units and alignment entries.

answers.description: The concerns this revision answers, and how.

markdown_ref.description: The rendered Markdown view of this revision.

needs_alignment.description: For a draft: the done or in-flight units that need an alignment entry.

needs_answer.description: For a draft: the track's open concerns it does not answer yet.

PlanProblem.description: One thing that blocks submitting a draft, and where.

PlanRef.description: The plan revision a claim or a job runs under, and where to read it.

PlanReview.description: A researcher's decision on a submitted plan revision.

PlanRevisionOut.description: A revision in a plan's history, without its units.

PlanUnitOut.description:
A unit as a plan revision lists it. `number` and `state` name its
hypothesis once it has one; `redo_of` is the unit it redoes.

hypothesis_revision.description: The hypothesis revision this entry wrote when its plan was approved.

control.description: Stored legacy controls remain readable, including empty and arbitrary objects.

tracks.description:
The project's first tracks, created with it. Each starts in `agent` mode
with the project default producer; `PATCH` a track to bind it.

ProjectLimits.description:
Size limits of what performers are handed, per project, in bytes (and
items for `context_items_max`).

ProjectTrackCreate.description: A track created with its project.

description.description: Markdown: the approach this track explores.

ReadMeasurement.description: Evidence reads include provenance that historical import records preserve.

ReportDocument.description:
A run's notes, the structured report of a claimed result sheet submitted
before run documents, or a separately represented legacy imported report.

RunFrontMatter.description: The front matter of a run document: what the run claims and what it ran.

RunNotesDocument.description: The Markdown body of a run document; empty when the run wrote no notes.

RunSubmission.description:
A run document: Markdown with YAML front matter, checked against
`GET /api/schemas/run`. The body holds optional run notes.

ScienceRevisionRequestDecide.description:
Who decides a written-up hypothesis: a researcher (the default when
absent), or the registered decider service account running its decider
step, which promotes only on a `pass` verdict.

ScienceRevisionRequestDecider.description: The decider service account and the revision of its decider step.

ScienceRevisionRequestVerifier.description: The verifier service account and the policy revision it applies.

ScienceRevisionRequestVerify.description:
How a science revision's attempts are verified: by a registered verifier
service account running `cannery runner`, or by an agent or a researcher
who did not run the attempt.

producer.description: Legacy stored references remain readable; new requests use `RequestCommonProducerRef`.

workflow.description: Legacy stored workflow metadata remains readable; new requests use `TrackCreateRequestWorkflow`.

UnitAlignmentOut.description: An approved plan's alignment entry about a unit.

UnitCreate.description:
A new unit of a plan draft. `acceptance` is the hypothesis acceptance
plan (splits, primary metric, criteria, gates, budget); `parameters` are
the project's hypothesis fields.

UnitHistoryOut.description: A unit's revisions and the alignment entries approved about it, oldest first.

UnitIndexOut.description: One line of a track's unit index.

obsolete.description: An approved plan made it obsolete (or redid it).

UnitOut.description: A unit: a hypothesis with the plan fields it was approved with.

plan_revision.description: The approved plan revision that last listed it, if any.

UnitRelation.description:
A typed relation of a unit: to a hypothesis of the project (its number),
of another project (`{project, number}`), or to another unit of the same
plan by key. Exactly one of `hypothesis` and `unit`.

UnitRevisionOut.description: One revision of a unit's hypothesis.

plan_revision.description: The approved plan revision that wrote it, if a plan did.

UnitUpdate.description:
Changes to a unit of a plan draft; omitted fields keep their value, and
`control` or `parameters` set to null are removed.

VerificationDocument.description: A published verification report: its front matter and its Markdown body.

VerificationGate.description: One gate of a verification report.

body_markdown.description: The report's Markdown body; null when it has none.

WriteupDocument.description: A published write-up: its front matter and its Markdown body.

WriteupOut.description:
A hypothesis's write-up: whether it is still to write, being written,
written or skipped, and what it covers and cites.

attempt_ref.description: The attempt the write-up is filed on: the hypothesis's last.

claimed_by.description: The service account that claimed the document job.

claimed_by_user.description: The researcher who claimed or skipped the document job.

context.description: The documenter's context bundle; absent when the attempt pinned no plan.

oneOf.description: What the write-up covers and cites; absent for an imported write-up.

job_id.description: The document job; absent for an imported write-up.

skip_reason.description: Why a researcher skipped the write-up.

WriteupQueueOut.description: The hypotheses waiting for their write-up, oldest first.

WriteupRequest.description:
A researcher writes a hypothesis up: the write-up, Markdown with YAML
front matter (`writeup.schema.json`).

WriteupSkipRequest.description: A researcher skips a hypothesis's write-up, and says why.

oneOf.description: The verification report a result case is about.
